answer: Proof of Stake acts as the kernel of Sybil resistance in decentralized AI networks, requiring agents to bond assets to validate operations. Like a stable jetty holding back a turbulent sea, this economic commitment bridges the canyon between low-cost identity creation and the prohibitive expense of acquiring sufficient stake. An attacker must commit vast capital to gain influence, ensuring that malicious behavior leads to immediate financial forfeiture, effectively deterring automated cloning.
